passage.text: Day 1: Hi, Emma! I've just arrived at my guesthouse on Khao San Road.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈwʌn: ˈhaɪ, ˈɛmə! aɪv ˈdʒʌst əˈraɪvd ət maɪ ˈɡɛsthaʊs ɑːn ˈkaʊ ˈsɑːn ˈroʊd.

passage.text: It's full of backpackers from around the world, and the street never sleeps!
passage.reading: ɪts ˈfʊl əv ˈbækpækərz frəm əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːrld, ənd ðə ˈstriːt ˈnɛvər ˈsliːps!

passage.text: Day 2: Your friend Nam was right. Wat Arun was worth visiting at sunset.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈtuː: jʊr ˈfrɛnd ˈnɑːm wʌz ˈraɪt. ˈwɑːt əˈruːn wʌz ˈwɜːrθ ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ ət ˈsʌnsɛt.

passage.text: Day 3: I'm writing this on the sleeper train to Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈθriː: aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ ðɪs ɑːn ðə ˈsliːpər ˌtreɪn tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: My bed is small but comfortable, and the staff gave me a clean pillow and blanket.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈbɛd ɪz ˈsmɔːl bʌt ˈkʌmftərbəl, ənd ðə ˈstæf ˈɡeɪv miː ə ˈkliːn ˈpɪloʊ ənd ˈblæŋkɪt.

passage.text: Day 4: I took a cooking class this morning and made green curry!
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈfɔːr: aɪ ˈtʊk ə ˈkʊkɪŋ ˌklæs ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ənd ˈmeɪd ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri!

passage.text: It was too spicy for me, but the teacher said that I had talent!
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈtuː ˈspaɪsi fər miː, bʌt ðə ˈtiːtʃər ˈsɛd ðæt aɪ ˈhæd ˈtælənt!

passage.text: Day 5: I flew to Krabi and took a ferry to Koh Phi Phi.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈfaɪv: aɪ ˈfluː tə ˈkrɑːbi ənd ˈtʊk ə ˈfɛri tə ˈkoʊ ˈpiː ˈpiː.

passage.text: The ferry was crowded, but the views were amazing.
passage.reading: ðə ˈfɛri wʌz ˈkraʊdɪd, bʌt ðə ˈvjuːz wɜːr əˈmeɪzɪŋ.

passage.text: Day 6: I went snorkeling and saw a turtle!
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈsɪks: aɪ ˈwɛnt ˈsnɔːrkəlɪŋ ənd ˈsɔː ə ˈtɜːrtəl!

passage.text: Day 7: I'm back in Bangkok, and I fly home tomorrow.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈsɛvən: aɪm ˈbæk ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ənd aɪ ˈflaɪ ˈhoʊm təˈmɑːroʊ.

passage.text: One week wasn't enough. I'm already planning my next trip!
passage.reading: ˈwʌn ˈwiːk ˈwʌzənt ɪˈnʌf. aɪm ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈplænɪŋ maɪ ˈnɛkst ˈtrɪp!
